spanish: Y hizo Moisés y Aarón como mandó Jehová a ellos; así hicieron.
grammarChanges: Replaced the calque "como que" with "como" before "mandó Jehová a ellos": "como que" is heard in current Latin American Spanish as semblance/hedge (as if), but כַּאֲשֶׁר only licenses plain correspondence (as/according as); "como" alone carries that sense without the hedge.
